metadata.title: Monochrome Theatrical Portrait with Art Deco Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A stark black-and-white composition featuring a central doorway frame, two figures in formal attire, and prominent Art Deco-inspired custom lettering across the top.
excludeWhen: busy or naturalistic backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, high-contrast black and white scene where two figures stand within a white architectural doorway frame against a pure white void. The top of the frame is dominated by stylized, geometric lettering with inline details and elongated descenders.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures framed by a central white doorway
Stark black silhouettes against a white background
Typography spanning the full width of the upper margin
Vertical emphasis through elongated limbs and letterforms
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette with no grayscale midtones
Geometric Art Deco lettering with double-line or inline effects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures centered horizontally, one tall and one short, positioned within the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tall figure in black formal wear and the architectural doorway.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography at the top, moves down the vertical lines of the doorway to the figures, and rests on the interaction between the two subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive pure white negative space surrounding the central subjects and framing the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Binary high-contrast; no saturation, extreme value difference.

letterConstructionRules: Variable width with wide 'M' and 'W' forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: First and last letters feature extreme vertical extensions
Curved elements are stylized into sharp arcs or geometric segments

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the retro Art Deco display feel
Geometric structure similar to the base skeleton

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio photograph of two figures in formal 19th-century attire standing inside a white wooden doorway frame against a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom Art Deco lettering across the top in black with a white inline, featuring elongated vertical strokes on the outer characters.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Does the typography feature an inline or double-line effect?
Are the figures framed by a central doorway?
Is the background pure white without shadows?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background consistency
Verify typography has the correct Art Deco inline style
Ensure no color bleed or grayscale artifacts
Confirm the doorway frame is centered
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome + Art Deco inline display type + Central architectural framing.
